root_cause.text: Use of non-synchronous timer deletion (timer_delete/del_timer) in lbs_free_adapter() allows a race condition where an in-flight timer callback (lbs_cmd_timeout_handler or lbs_tx_lockup_handler) may execute after the enclosing lbs_private structure is freed, leading to use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes timer_delete to timer_delete_sync for both command_timer and tx_lockup_timer. The commit message states that timer_delete does not wait for running callbacks, and both callbacks access priv fields (driver_lock, cur_cmd, dev) which would be use-after-free after lbs_cfg_free() frees the structure.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix race condition by using synchronized timer deletion to avoid use-after-free during adapter cleanup.
intent_record.what: Changed timer_delete() to timer_delete_sync() for both command_timer and tx_lockup_timer in lbs_free_adapter().
intent_record.how: Ensures that the timer deletion waits for any currently executing timer callback to complete before freeing the adapter, preventing potential use-after-free races.
